about: Ali Traders and Ali Polymers is a trusted manufacturer and wholesale supplier with over 30 years of experience in polymer-based products. Based in Perumbavoor, Ernakulam, Kerala, India, we serve customers across India and global markets with durable solutions for agriculture, construction, packaging, rain protection, and household applications. Using 100% virgin, semi-virgin, and reprocessed raw materials, we deliver premium, standard, and economical products trusted for their quality, reliability, and value
structure: Ali Traders and Ali Polymers operate as an integrated manufacturing, sourcing, and wholesale distribution organization. While Ali Polymers focuses on product development and sourcing, Ali Traders manages logistics and market reach across Kerala and expanding export destinations.
vision: To be a reliable global supplier of quality plastic products.
mission: To deliver durable, cost effective polymer solutions through ethical practices and consistent quality.
whyChooseUs: 30+ years of manufacturing quality tarpaulins, shade nets, ropes, and polymer products—crafted in Kerala, trusted worldwide
18+ product categories under one roof — fewer suppliers to manage, one point of contact for your full requirement
Multiple own brands (NEXATARP, NEXANET, NEXAWEED) — built for premium, standard, and economy segments
Material flexibility — 100% virgin, semi-virgin, and recycled-grade options to match your budget and application
In-house quality control at every production stage, ensuring consistent specs across every batch
Export-ready & customizable — tailored dimensions, GSM, packaging, and container-load documentation support
Committed to sustainable manufacturing — recycled-grade materials reduce plastic waste without compromising strength

export.intro: Ali Traders & Ali Polymers provide export ready supply solutions for international buyers, distributors, and project contractors. Our products are manufactured to meet global quality expectations while offering competitive pricing and flexible specifications.
export.markets: Supporting domestic supply across India and expanding exports to the Middle East, Africa, and Asian markets with reliable shipping solutions.
